_color_note: Daedalus Design DARK LABYRINTH palette (reference: 3D circular-maze artwork): near-black navy abyss, extruded steel maze walls, light warm ink, the logo's brushed copper as the chromatic accent, holo-teal (#6FD3CF) for focus rings and beams. Paper survives as light text on panels and as the 'paper' demo tiles. All text tokens AA-checked (>=4.5:1) on abyss and surface.

layout.grid: full-viewport snap sections (100svh, scroll-snap mandatory), content max-width 1152px, 24px side padding

voice: Confident and concise. No hype, no exclamation points. Serbian first, English second.
signature_element: The labyrinth: a generated 3D circular maze (extruded walls, parallax bands, copper core) fills the landing page; every later section carries the same maze in a quieter register (tiled wall field + one extruded circular motif). Smoked-navy liquid glass on the navbar/buttons; copper as hover/accent; rounded-full pills and rounded-2xl cards.
